property_summary: For every call to version(), the reference contract always returns the string "1.0.0"; the mutant returns a different string for some input (e.g. it returns "1.1.0"), so asserting the exact returned bytes matches "1.0.0" distinguishes them.
change_summary: Change the returned version string from "1.0.0" to "1.1.0" (minor bump).
mutated_unit_code: function version() external pure returns (string memory) { return "1.1.0"; }
